items.title: 16.7 Tests for identification of basic radicals (basic radicals pehchanne ke tests) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.7 with Quick Check 16.4, printed pages 345-348.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Basic radicals (cations, yani positive ions) ki pehchan ke liye aam taur par sample ko distilled water mein ghol kar solution do hisson mein baanta jata hai: ek hisse mein NaOH solution aur doosre mein aqueous ammonia dala jata hai. Precipitate ka rang aur zyada reagent (excess) mein us ka ghulna ya na ghulna ion batata hai.
Saaf test tube mein 4 g solid sample lein. Taqreeban 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Aluminium radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein taqreeban 5 cm³ NaOH solution dalein.
White gelatinous (jelly jaisa safed) precipitate banta hai.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia ke chand qatre dalein.
